title: Jib Dodger
description: Jib Dodger was one of the New Republic X-wing pilots who answered a distress beacon initiated by the lone human crew member aboard a prison transport. The tracking signal went live during the attempt to break out Twi'lek criminal Qin. The Mandalorian, Din Djarin, hid the beacon on Qin. The X-wing pilots arrived and destroyed Ranzar Malk's station.
